name: Project Forge
subtitle: ChatGPT Project Forge
description: A preparation system for opening ChatGPT Projects from explicit files instead of hidden chat continuity.
purpose: Prepare the startup package before the real work begins, so the target project can start from a visible basis instead of reconstructing scope, sources, constraints, and decisions from previous conversation.
boundary: The core defines the rules; the project package carries the state.

core_surfaces.meaning: files used to open one target project
sources or notes that are not official yet
only when continuity is really required

canonical_files.role: System identity, scope, non-scope, target, final output.
Criteria, authority, stability, residence, validation, readiness, handoff.
Artifact grammar, artifact classes, schemas, triggers, freshness rules.
Minimum working procedure, states, output minimums, stop conditions.

minimum.purpose: Tells the target project how to read the package.
Defines objective, scope, expected outputs, and project-specific constraints.
Freezes the initial official basis of the target project.

optional.purpose: Transfers current state when the next run cannot be reconstructed safely.
Transfers candidate materials without making them official basis yet.

opening_package_artifacts.rule: Do not generate every surface by default.

usage_paths: File-based agent such as Codex, IDE assistant, or CLI agent

readiness_states.meaning: Material is missing or weak, but the frame remains coherent.
A structural condition is missing, invalid, or unavailable.
Peer-authority surfaces diverge and cannot be closed at the current level.

stop_conditions: the real object is not closed
target closure changes the move materially
a lower surface attempts to redefine a higher surface
a required artifact class is undefined
a forbidden stability-to-residence combination is attempted
immutable fields are targeted by runtime override
